title: Plant Manager
text:
**Overview**
The
**Plant Manager**
is a strategic leader entrusted with overseeing all operational activities at our Sauget, IL facility (Greater St. Louis area). Reporting to the business unit President, the Plant Manager will play a critical role in driving safety, operational excellence, customer satisfaction, continuous improvement, and frontline obsession. You will also provide exceptional leadership and professional development to the Operations team. The successful candidate will have strong people leadership skills, the ability to easily communicate strategy and direction to all levels of the organization, a demonstrated track record of operational success, and working knowledge of Lean principles. They will constantly strive to exceed customer expectations through excellent customer service levels and customer-first customization.
 
 
Established in 1959 and headquartered in Sauget, IL, Universal Air Filter (UAF) is part of Filtration Group LLC, the world’s leading filtration company. UAF designs and manufactures custom air filters used to protect commercial equipment and electronics enclosures. With exceptional design and application knowledge and understanding of thermal management in complex equipment and cabinets, UAF is a valuable partner for global OEMs serving all types of electronics and industrial machinery end markets. Engineering design support and quick-turn, custom prototypes are provided to engineer prospects and customers operating under ambitious product development cycles. UAF filters are engineered to address the challenges of thermal management, dust contamination, airflow control, fire safety, EMI shielding, and size limitations in crowded electronic enclosures.
 
 
**Responsibilities**
Reporting to the business unit President, the Plant Manager will play a critical role in driving safety, operational excellence, customer satisfaction, continuous improvement, and frontline obsession. You will also provide exceptional leadership and professional development to the Operations team. The successful candidate will have strong people leadership skills, the ability to easily communicate strategy and direction to all levels of the organization, a demonstrated track record of operational success, and working knowledge of Lean principles. They will constantly strive to exceed customer expectations through excellent customer service levels and customer-first customization.
 
 
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s of Science in Engineering or similar. Concentration in Mechanical, Civil, Systems, or Chemical Engineering strongly preferred.
* MBA/advanced degree a plus
* 10+ years of Operations experience in a manufacturing environment
* 5+ years of experience leading operations and/or supply chain teams, preferably in a batch or custom products environment
* Hands-on experience in implementing and driving sustainable performance
* Pay Salaried ($120,000)
